title: Prefix and Suffix with Font Attributes

illustrates.quote: Ignore font attributes used with word parts standing alone, e.g., prefixes, suffixes, and identified root words. Note this change on the Transcriber’s Notes page.

blocks.features: Three short word-part fragments stacked one per line in a bordered box: 'dis-' bold, 'ible' italic, '-ance' bold.

print.notes: No heading; the box is simply the three word-part items, one per line.
print.surroundingText: Follows rule 5.3.3 directly; second of two examples (5-1, 5-2) sharing printed page 5-3.
print.printFeatures: Small bordered box, three short stacked lines, black serif text.

braille.notes: Three lines, flush left, margin 8 stripped. Verified letter-by-letter against a 400dpi render of PDF p.129 by pixel-decoding each 6-dot cell (run A): line 1 = d,i,s,hyphen; line 2 = i,b,l,e; line 3 = hyphen,a,n,c,e — confirms these are genuine uncontracted braille spellings identical to the .txt extraction, not print-only picture text mislabelled as braille. No typeform indicators appear: both bold and italic are dropped, per 5.3.3.

resolution: Both runs agree on the braille (independently pixel-verified by run A against PDF p.129) and on the underlying print facts (three word-parts, differing weights); only prose wording differed, synthesized here.
